title: feat(floret): use shared MCP media tools
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces Floret’s private shell with caller-authenticated Computer and FFmpeg MCP tools.
- Adds downloadable 3D generation through the existing durable route.
- Retires shell container code, bindings, Docker dependencies, and CI coverage.
- Verifies MCP file creation, media editing/publishing, and retired-shell deployment configuration.

gist.headline: Floret borrows better tools
gist.blurb: Floret has traded its private shell shed for shared, caller-authenticated MCP tools. It can now create, edit, publish, and hand you downloadable 3D work without keeping a tiny container kingdom alive.
gist.summary: Floret now uses the shared caller-authenticated Computer and FFmpeg MCP tools instead of its private shell, while adding downloadable 3D generation through the existing durable media route.
gist.impact: Floret users gain authenticated file and media workflows—including editable, publishable media and downloadable 3D outputs—backed by the shared MCP toolchain rather than a separate shell container.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Floret as a cozy digital flower workshop: Polli helps a friendly CRT monitor robot use shared toolboxes labeled Computer and FFmpeg to shape a small downloadable 3D flower model. Show a durable glowing parcel or download arrow leaving the workshop, with code-plants and garden vines representing the shared MCP infrastructure replacing the old private shell.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny tool belt, warmly helping a chunky CRT monitor robot use two shared toolboxes labeled “COMPUTER” and “FFMPEG” to sculpt a small 3D pixel flower that is being packed into a glowing download parcel. Lime green (#ecf874) is prominent across the garden-workshop, with code-plants, pastel mint and peach gradients, and subtle pixel-font text “SHARED TOOLS”; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
